decision_details.scope: Current pinned TokenSpeed-to-native-vLLM routing/input-quantization adaptation on B300:2; isolated boundary only.
decision_details.summary: 24 eligible performance cases; 0 cases with reported numerical mismatches; original serving baseline preserved.
reasons: The current adaptation regresses T=1 decode in both native formats on synchronized wall and each GPU, with all ten paired differences positive and mean difference exceeding three sample standard deviations.

notes: Synthetic realistic-routing proxies are not captured model activations.
Synchronized wall covers the invoked device sequence; GPU durations are never summed into request latency.
CUDA events measure current streams. Required stream joins and layout conversions must be inside invoke.
Memory peaks include resident allocations from both variants; incremental peaks are above each sample's starting allocation.
Declared scratch is adapter metadata; PyTorch allocator peaks omit external CUDA allocations.
Compilation, canonical correctness checks, and five warmups are outside measured intervals.
This unprofiled microbenchmark does not measure kernel counts, HBM traffic, PDL benefits, or request latency.
Eager CUDA-event intervals may include GPU idle gaps from host dispatch. Graph replay removes repeated Python dispatch but is not a direct sum of kernel durations.
A single case cannot authorize integration; repeatability and the remaining shapes require separate evidence.
